title: They don't give you enough magnets...
text:
They don't give you enough magnets.... THE GOOD:
--------------
* Universally sized so it should work with most home washer and dryers.
* Keeps clothing from falling off the back.

THE BAD:
------------
* Not enough magnets. Sure they're earth magnets, but they're small and spaced too far apart. There needs to be more of them. I think the bottom should be one long strip of earth magnet. Actually, I bet you that it doesn't have to be earth magnets. It can be standard tape magnet, but if it's continuous and covers the entire bottom rails, I bet you that would be stronger than small earth magnets that are spaced far a apart.
* Moves easily. You can flick it with your fingers and the entire wall wobbles. Again, this is due to not having enough magnets.
* For best strength, DO NOT connect the middle. It just so happens that in my situation, I need to split the middle anyway because there is a shelf bracket in the way. But even if I didn't have this shelf bracket, I would still split the middle. The reason is because if you connect the entire thing, then the entire width will be much shorter than the entire width of both your washer and dryer. The top of washer and dryers machines will also vary in design, some have raised edges, which makes it tricky to make sure all the brackets are connected on the same raised level. So I just split it up. This way, it's easier to manipulate how and where I want the brackets to stick. This may sound confusing, but you'll see once you buy it.

Overall, this is a so-so product. Every day we're fixing the brackets cause it gets moved a lot. So it's doing it's job in terms of not letting your socks fall off the edges, but it is not sturdy. I will install extra earth magnets when I have the time. I'll go 3-Stars.
